title: Substrate-Aware AI Agents: Execution Context as a First-Class Input
abstract: arXiv:2609.05232v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous AI agents increasingly select actions in environments whose memory, execution-time, runtime, compute, and operational constraints determine what counts as a suitable plan. We call the absence of this execution context from an agent's planning state substrate blindness. We test this general proposition through numerical code generation, where selected implementation choices and operational consequences are directly observable. Three frontier model configurations--Anthropic Claude Opus 5, OpenAI GPT-5.6-Sol, and Google Gemini 3.7 Flash--generate code for a high-dimensional pairwise Euclidean-distance task either from the task alone or with a 128 MB RAM and 10.0 s wall-time contract. Contract disclosure reduced measured peak process memory in 13 of 14 executable index-aligned task-only versus contract-disclosed comparisons and reduced mean wall time in all three cohorts, making execution up to 3.1x faster. translated_title: 底座感知的AI智能体：将执行上下文作为一等输入
translated_abstract: 自主AI智能体越来越多地在其内存、执行时间、运行时、计算能力和运营约束决定何种计划才算合适的环境中选择行动。我们将这种执行上下文在智能体规划状态中的缺失称为“底座盲”。我们通过数值代码生成来检验这一普遍命题，因为在代码生成场景中，所选实现方案及其运行后果可直接观测。三种前沿模型配置——Anthropic Claude Opus 5、OpenAI GPT-5.6-Sol和Google Gemini 3.7 Flash——针对一个高维两两欧氏距离任务生成代码，方式为仅依据任务描述，或在提供128 MB内存和10.0秒运行时间约束契约的条件下进行。在14组可执行且索引对齐的“仅任务 vs 契约披露”对比中，契约披露在其中13组降低了实测峰值进程内存，并在全部三个模型组中降低了平均运行时间，使执行速度最高提升3.1倍。在经过审计的语料……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文提出“底座盲”概念，即智能体规划状态中缺失执行上下文，并通过三款前沿模型的高维欧氏距离代码生成实验证明，向模型披露128 MB内存与10秒运行时间的约束契约能显著降低峰值内存并使执行速度最高提升3.1倍。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "substrate blindness"—the absence of execution context from an agent's planning state—and shows through high-dimensional pairwise Euclidean-distance code generation experiments with three frontier models that disclosing a 128 MB RAM and 10.0 s wall-time contract significantly reduces peak memory and speeds up execution by up to 3.1x.
